risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty screen.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting up and displaying the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system settings.
Video of a game disc being inserted and played.
Photo of the front of the console to check for scratches or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
